## Summary

Explain the problem, the bounded change, and why this approach is appropriate.

## Evidence

List the exact commands and results used to verify this commit.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran every affected suite (or explained why a suite does not apply).
- [ ] I ran `python3 tools/leak_scan.py`.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible or operational changes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavioral changes.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, or identifying paths.
- [ ] I did not change a version; version changes belong in an authorized release-train ticket.
- [ ] I listed the exact tested commit and changed files for review.
